sloka: नाभागस्य भभूव अज अजात् दशरथो अभवत् ।अस्मात् दशरथात् जातौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥१-७०-४३॥
transliteration: nābhāgasya bhabhūva aja ajāt daśaratho abhavat ।asmāt daśarathāt jātau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥1-70-43॥

translations.english: Nabhaga's son was Aja. Aja was the father of Dasaratha and Dasaratha, the father of Rama and Lakshmana.
